title: Roomlumen: AI Room Design

candidates.name: Roomlumen: AI Room Design
candidates.why: The chosen candidate. Room is the subject of the job and lumen is the unit of light, so the carrier is made of the wedge's own two halves rather than decorating it, and AI Room Design is a phrase measured as a real Play query on this shelf. It is the highest-scoring candidate that survives the rejection list.

candidates.name: Svetlo: AI Room Design
candidates.why: Leads on distinctiveness, because nothing like it stands in this shelf's titles, and it means light in a locale the factory ships; but heard once by someone who does not know Slavic orthography it has more than one plausible rendering, which is a rejection-list item and puts its radio dimension below the floor, so it is eliminated by a hard check rather than by its score.

candidates.name: Keeplight: AI Room Design
candidates.why: Coinage that states the wedge directly, keep the room and change the light, and it sits comfortably inside the character cap; it loses because its Play collision check was not run in this session, so its uniqueness score is a guess where the chosen candidate's is a measurement.

candidates.name: Roomlume: AI Room Design
candidates.why: A compound of the same two ideas with one syllable fewer, which makes the title shorter but truncates lumen into lume: the missing letter is invisible when the name is heard, so a listener may type the longer form of our own name, and its Play search surfaced the Roomly, Roombie, Roomellow and Roomlify cluster.

candidates.name: Onewall: AI Room Design
candidates.why: Evokes changing one wall, which is the wedge, and it passes the radio test well; it collides with a live app, OneWall Communities at com.venn.onewall, and the same search surfaced One Wall Street and One4Wall, so its uniqueness dimension sits below the floor and the field has to be regenerated rather than defended.

candidates.name: AI Interior Design
candidates.why: The negative control: the bare category head term that the shelf's 10M+ and 50M+ leaders already own, and the kind of title this factory once shipped for a utility. It scores at the top on searchability and radio test and at the bottom on distinctiveness and uniqueness, and it loses to every serious candidate, which is what a negative control is for.

rejected.name: Svetlo: AI Room Design
rejected.reason: Eliminated by the rejection list rather than by its score: heard once by a listener who has not seen it, a Slavic word carries more than one plausible spelling for an English-speaking user, which is the rejection-list item about a name that needs a pronunciation guide or has more than one plausible spelling.

rejected.name: Roomlume: AI Room Design
rejected.reason: Lost on the radio test and on distinctiveness together: the truncation of lumen to lume is audible in no way at all, so a listener types the longer form of our own name, and the exact string sits inside a measured cluster of Room-prefixed AI room apps.

rejected.name: Onewall: AI Room Design
rejected.reason: A measured collision, not a taste judgement: a Play search for the string surfaced OneWall Communities at com.venn.onewall, One Wall Street and One4Wall, so the name is not ours to take and its uniqueness dimension fell below the required floor.

rejected.name: Keeplight: AI Room Design
rejected.reason: Rejected on process rather than on art: its collision check was not run in this session, so choosing it would have meant shipping the factory's strongest ranking field on an unmeasured word, while the chosen name carries a measured Play reading.

rejected.name: AI Interior Design
rejected.reason: The negative control and the category defect this factory has already paid for once: it is the bare head term every incumbent above already ranks for, and a title that names the category gives a user no reason to prefer this app over a 10M-install leader.

audience: A householder or renter redecorating or deciding whether to redecorate, and a homeowner staging a room to sell: someone who already has the room in their hand as a phone photo and wants to see one change before spending money on paint, flooring or furniture.
rationale: A carrier plus the real two-to-three-word job noun is the recommended shape for a small focused tool, and this one is built from the job's own parts: room is what is kept and lumen is the unit of the light that the wedge turns into a control, while AI Room Design is a phrase measured as a real Play query on this shelf. The chosen name is the highest-scoring candidate that survives the rejection list, which eliminated a higher-scoring borrowed word for its radio test and a same-shaped compound for its audibility.
collisionCheck: MEASURED, partially. A Play title search for the exact carrier and its near neighbours was run on 2026-10-16 with scripts/scan-titles.mjs, both readings on disk: .kiln/scratch/recon-2026-10-16/scan-titles-naming.md (roomlumen, roomlight, lumenroom) and .kiln/scratch/recon-2026-10-16/scan-titles-naming-rejected.md (sunroom, afterglow, onewall). The exact string roomlumen returned 0 apps carrying it; roomlight, lumenroom, sunroom, afterglow and onewall were each rejected on what the same search surfaced. UNVERIFIED: no trademark register was queried, so this is a search reading and not clearance, and a clean Play search is not legal clearance.
localisationCheck: Twenty-five characters in en-US and twenty-four in ru-RU, both inside Play's thirty-character cap with five and six characters of slack, and neither string is a machine translation. The carrier stays Latin in both locales, as the methodology allows for a compound carrier whose parts are recognisable words. Whether a Russian-speaking user reads a Latin carrier as the brand rather than as a word to translate is unmeasured and needs a native review before the listing is written.
